0022600175.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-6, 0-3 on the road, losers of three straight) visit the Boston Celtics (5-2, 4-0 at home, coming off a loss), with Milwaukee sitting 14th in the East and Boston 3rd. Devin Carter is out for the Celtics with an illness, while Jayson Tatum (rest) and Payton Pritchard (shoulder) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Boston won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 133-101 win over Milwaukee in Milwaukee on April 3, 2026.
